text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And we have a winner! A stunning<n>victory for our
new junior champion!<n>Finishing in second place is...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(The sounds of pounding feet are still<n>ringing in my
ears.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
("Thud, thud, thud"... As I charged to<n>take the lead,
there were others right<n>on my tail.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(But in that final moment, I felt sure<n>that the one
crossing the finish line<n>first... would be me.)
WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The incredible times displayed up on<n>the digital
scoreboard are far quicker<n>than I had expected.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In other words, Ines Fujin couldn't<n>afford to let her
guard down even for<n>a moment. That also meant
she had<n>no chance to conserve any energy.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Phew... Huff!
choice_data_list: Ines, you did great making it to the end!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aha... Yeah... Thanks, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... I did it...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha... I'm okay. I just need to... catch<n>my breath for
a minute...
choice_data_list: I'll bring a stretcher right away!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahh... Hehe... Geez.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You're such a worrywart...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff... My body's really hot... but thebreeze feels nice...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe she managed to finish<n>a G1 race
through sheer willpower.<n>Now that's what I call a
unique<n>competitor.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
It seems her body just couldn't keep<n>up with her
spirit. Well, hmm... She's<n>a bit rough around the
edges, but...

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text: Wow. That was totally crazy! Ines is<n>straight fire!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
For real. She went wild out there. She<n>ran until she
couldn't even stand<n>anymore...

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Insane. She ran with everything she<n>had, and it
looked like she was<n>having a blast...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ryan, I wish we could have<n>competed too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I feel the same way. I really<n>wanted to race
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll be the one flying over<n>that finish line.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right! Up and at 'em! Ines Fujin is<n>back in
action!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're all right?
Are you sure you're all right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, quit worrying so much! The<n>infirmary doctor
just got angry at you<n>for that, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I just need a little rest, and I'll be<n>good as new.
You're blowing things<n>way out of proportion,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, now that the Asahi Hai Futurity<n>Stakes is
behind us, what's our next<n>goal?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho is the first race of the<n>Classic
Triple Crown. Based on<n>today's performance, Ines
Fujin<n>should have what it takes to compete<n>there,
too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. Great response. That's my<n>little trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. Great response. That's my<n>little trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't sweat the small stuff!<n>Let's do our
best to prepare for the<n>Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Goood morning!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Oh, m-morning! So, um... Ines!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Ines, can you come around to the<n>back for a
second?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Boss? Sure, no problem!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What's up?

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're here. I'll get straight to the<n>point.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Are you sure you want to keep<n>working here?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Erm, what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
I saw you on TV the other day. Seems<n>you put on a
great performance in the<n>Asahi Hai F.S.

text_block_list.name: TV Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
"Next year's Classics should be a<n>sight to behold!
There's an<n>abundance of talented racers set to
compete, including the Mejiro<n>family's rising star!"

text_block_list.name: Racing Critic
text_block_list.text:
"But that Ines Fujin... Don't you think<n>it was a bit
early for her to be taking<n>on a race like the Asahi
Hai?"

text_block_list.name: Racing Critic
text_block_list.text:
"She clearly needs to build more<n>muscle, and her
core stability was<n>lacking. If only she'd spent more
time<n>preparing, she may have been able to<n>set a
new record."

text_block_list.name: TV Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
"Oho... So put another way, you're<n>saying that with
the right training, Ines<n>Fujin will be unstoppable?"

text_block_list.name: Racing Critic
text_block_list.text:
"Well, she's definitely got the talent<n>to do great
things."

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
I did a little digging online, and<n>apparently that critic
is really harsh.<n>Getting praised the way you did is a
big deal!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
And that got me thinking. It's not just<n>your
trainer—everyone in the racing<n>scene has high
hopes for you.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
What do you think about taking a<n>break from
working here next year?<n>I'll keep you on the
books, so you<n>can always come back.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
I know you've got your family to<n>think about... But if
you ever need<n>anything, no matter how small, I'm
always here to listen.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: People have high hopes for me, huh...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Things have gotten all complicated all<n>of a sudden.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I'd like to continue working if<n>possible.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Even if it's just for peace of mind, I<n>want to give a
little back to my family<n>for letting me come here to
pursue my<n>dream.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(And in that same way, I want my<n>little sisters to be
able to chase their<n>dreams, too.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(If I can create even a bit more<n>leeway for my
family, then I'd like to<n>do what I can to help out.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I know everyone's concerned<n>about what's
best for me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Most of the other students are able to<n>devote all of
their focus to racing. And<n>that might start to matter
more as I<n>compete on bigger stages...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what Trainer really thinks<n>about all the
part-time work I'm<n>doing...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
They'd probably prefer it if I focused<n>all my efforts
on winning the Satsuki<n>Sho, huh...
